# Fisher Scientific Canada

> > Fisher Scientific Canada's e-commerce platform for laboratory supplies, scientific equipment, and safety resources serving Canadian research and industrial laboratories.

Fisher Scientific Canada (fisherfast.fishersci.ca) is the Canadian division of Thermo Fisher Scientific, providing online access to laboratory products, equipment procurement, and safety documentation including MSDS/SDS resources in both English and French.

## Key Topics

- Fisher Scientific
- Thermo Fisher Scientific
- Laboratory supplies
- Scientific equipment
- MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheets)
- Safety data sheets
- E-commerce platform
- Canadian laboratory services
- Product safety documentation
- Bilingual support (English/French)
- Research equipment
- Industrial laboratory solutions

## Main Platform

- [Fisher Scientific Canada Homepage](https://fisherfast.fishersci.ca/home.do): Main landing page for browsing and ordering laboratory supplies and scientific equipment in Canada

## Safety & Documentation

- [MSDS Search (French)](https://fisherfast.fishersci.ca/msdsSearchResults.do?msdsKeyword=&lang=fr): Search and access Material Safety Data Sheets and product safety documentation in French
